metadata.title: Convergence of finite element exterior calculus for the Hodge-Dirac and Hodge-Laplace problems on closed Riemannian manifolds
metadata.abstract: We prove that the finite element exterior calculus (FEEC) approximation to the Hodge-Dirac and Hodge-Laplace problems on any closed oriented Riemannian manifold converges. Its approximate solutions, together with their exterior derivatives, converge to the continuum solutions for every source, and at the rate of the mesh size when the source and its codifferential are square integrable. We use Licht's estimate for the FEEC approximation of forms with one square-integrable derivative by finite element forms. We combine this with a new abstract error bound for approximations of Hilbert complexes. This bound uses a version of Di Pietro and Droniou's third Strang lemma. To apply these estimates, we show that every closed manifold admits a family of arbitrarily fine triangulations whose shapes stay uniformly under control.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 闭黎曼流形上FEEC的Hodge问题收敛
analysis.workSummary: 证明任意闭定向黎曼流形上Hodge–Dirac与Hodge–Laplace问题的FEEC近似收敛：对每个源项，近似解及外微分收敛；源项和余微分平方可积时具有网格尺度的一阶速率。结合Licht微分形式逼近估计与基于第三Strang引理的新Hilbert复形抽象误差界。
techniques: 形状一致受控的任意细三角剖分
analysis.breakthrough: 把任意闭流形的网格存在性与抽象分析结合，支持几何PDE的普适离散逼近。
analysis.limitations: 速率结论有额外源项正则性，不是任意粗糙源项都有一阶收敛；闭定向条件不含边界问题。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
